description.zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The end of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记 （第一页没有）。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

description.zh:
排序顺序。目前只支持两种：
- CreateTimeDesc：按创建时间降序
- CreateTimeAsc：按创建时间升序
description.en:
The order that you use to sort the query results. Valid values:

- CreateTimeDesc: sorts the query results by creation time in descending order.

- CreateTimeAsc: sorts the query results by creation time in ascending order.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The beginning of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh:
任务状态 

- Init: 已提交, 
- Success: 成功, 
- Fail: 失败
description.en:
The state of the job. Valid values:

- Init: The job is submitted.

- Success: The job is successful.

- Fail: The job failed.

title.zh: 查询媒体信息任务列表
